result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_radius()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get graph radius (minimum eccentricity). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L17280-L17320){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_radius(unconnected=True) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The radius is the minimum of all node eccentricities. Nodes with eccentricity equal to the radius form the center of the graph. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [unconnected]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, computes minimum radius across all connected components. If `False`, returns `None` for disconnected graphs. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Minimum eccentricity, or `None` if disconnected (when `unconnected=False`). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Calculate radius of a star graph: ::: {#8b77abcb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="hub") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("hub", "A") .add_edge("hub", "B") .add_edge("hub", "C") ) # Returns 1 (hub is center) graph.get_radius() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: :::
